# Status light per device, backup and restore, tidier settings
### New
- **Status light in the device list:** if a frame has a problem it shows right in the list under "Devices", without pressing "Check tablet": a coloured dot and one sentence ("⚠ App outdated", "✗ Battery low, not charging", "Picture no longer changes", "Charge limit reports an error"). The server only evaluates what the device reports itself. With a charge limit, 30 % without power counts as normal; the warning comes at 15 % like the Pushover message.
- **Backup and restore** (Settings → Access → Backup): one file with the settings, all devices and the remembered shows. Passwords, calendar links and Pushover are included only if you tick it explicitly. When restoring, Frameside first shows what the file contains (new and existing devices, shows) and asks; everything goes through the same checks as the normal dialogs.
### Changed
- **The tablet check starts with one line:** "✓ All good" or "⚠ 2 notes". The notes stay visible, the rest (all fine, info) opens under "All details".
- **The general settings are organised in three tabs** (General, Notifications, Access) and, like the device dialog, have a clear Standard and Expert view.
- **A show can now have up to 5000 photos** (before: 1000). The TV route and AirPlay videos keep their own, smaller limits. For very large amounts the permanent programme with sources is still the better choice.
- **Old entries in the "Recently shown" history disappear after 30 days** (remembered shows stay).

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
